description:
A desktop workspace for local inference with Strata: prepare the runtime, manage models and services, and monitor your local API.

Strata Manager is an open-source desktop app for managing Niko1221/Strata, a local LLM inference engine. It bundles runtime setup, model downloads, service controls, streaming chat, hardware and API usage monitoring, task-based tuning, and benchmarking into a single workspace. Model weights already on your machine stay untouched.
- Allow safe same-port switching during concurrency comparison (#232): fixed STARTUP_PORT_IN_USE errors when switching between managed configurations that share the same listening port. Preflight now validates replacement bind compatibility and held-process ownership before draining, unloading, and stopping the previous service, waiting for retired managed listeners to exit before starting the candidate with rollback protection, while still blocking foreign listeners.
- Support and autocomplete --draft arguments in full parameter configuration (#229): registered --draft, --draft-model, and --draft-conf as 1-operand engine flags, merged engine --help flags into argument-name autocomplete in the full engine argument list, and offered dflash2 operand suggestions on existing --draft rows.
